name: Inline Error
summary: Text-first field error message with a required message node, optional decorative icon, explicit static/dynamic announcement policy, and control-association requirements.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Visible text identifying the error and, when known, how to correct it.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional icon that supports, but does not replace, the error text.

states.name: default
states.description: Static associated error text with no automatic live announcement.

states.name: politeAnnouncement
states.description: Routine dynamically updated feedback is announced without interrupting the current task.

states.name: assertiveAnnouncement
states.description: Urgent dynamically inserted feedback may interrupt the current announcement.

behavior.name: errorAssociation
behavior.description: The error message should be associated with the invalid field it describes.

behavior.name: announcement
behavior.description: Static messages default to no live role. Targets deliberately choose polite or assertive announcement for dynamic feedback and own the live-region lifecycle.

behavior.name: iconSemantics
behavior.description: Decorative error icons should not duplicate the text announcement.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Visible text identifying the invalid field's error and, when known, how to correct it.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional decorative error icon that does not replace the message.

properties.name: announcement
properties.description: Explicit live-announcement priority for dynamically inserted or updated feedback; static associated errors remain none.

accessibility: Use text, not icon or color alone, to explain the error.
Associate the message with the invalid control using aria-describedby.
Set aria-invalid="true" on the invalid control.
Default static errors to no live role when the invalid control already references the message.
Use polite announcement for routine dynamic feedback and assertive only when interruption is necessary.
Keep decorative icons hidden from assistive technology.
Reject empty messages; icon and color never replace explanatory text.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/forms.css with no runtime; association, insertion timing, and live-region lifecycle remain target responsibilities.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render validation messages with matching ids and form control references.
